# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

Work in progress for 3.119.5, backporting Apple TFM support and a WinUI DLL fix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs** — Brings the newer Apple target framework moniker support back to the 3.119.x servicing line. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — Resolves a missing native DLL error when consuming SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI from .NET 9 apps. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
